transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile roaming support, my name is Jason. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, my name is Tariq Mansoor. I landed at Frankfurt Airport in Germany two hours ago for an urgent European trade exhibition, but my mobile data roaming is completely blocked and shows 'PDP authentication failure', leaving me stranded with no maps, no email, and no connection!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can query the European roaming subscriber registers. What is the mobile phone number and account number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile number is 07700 900381, account number SN-881920, registered to 14 Wellington Street, Slough, SL1 1YP, security PIN 5521.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me open mobile subscriber record 07700 900381 on the international gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please check why mobile data is barred.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the Deutsche Telekom roaming partner HLR database?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The international roaming database indicates that an automated roaming cap bar was applied.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: An automated roaming cap bar?! I specifically paid forty pounds last week for the unlimited European Roaming Pass before leaving the UK! Why did S-Net take my forty pounds and then bar my data the moment my plane touched down?! This is sheer incompetence!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration and anger, especially having paid forty pounds for the European Roaming Pass in advance and arriving in Frankfurt only to find your data barred. Let us get this restriction lifted so your mobile data connects immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Jason, please lift it immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: International cellular handovers require clearance from foreign host network servers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Deutsche Telekom is Germany's largest network; it should take seconds to clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating that international data tariffs require proper device provisioning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Jason? Are you still on the phone? The line went completely dead for forty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was waiting for the roaming gateway interface to respond.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you remove the cap bar from my SIM card right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously international cellular handovers require clearance from foreign host network servers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Deutsche Telekom is Germany's largest network; it should take seconds to clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am sending a roaming bar removal command to the Frankfurt gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long will that command take to execute?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am the managing director of a renewable energy manufacturing firm, and in thirty minutes I have a live pitch presentation to German infrastructure investors at the Frankfurt Messe convention center! The presentation deck, my client contact files, and the venue entry QR codes are all stored in our cloud drive! If I cannot access my data, our multi-million-euro investment deal will collapse and thirty jobs in our factory will be lost! I am having a severe panic attack!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You should check your Access Point Name settings in your smartphone mobile data menu.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you even hear what I just said about thirty factory jobs and an investment deal?! You don't give a damn about my crisis!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you travel across Europe on multi-million-euro business without verifying international roaming in advance, that is your own reckless carelessness.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine! What should the APN be set to?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The APN field should be set to 'mobile.snet.co.uk' with username blank.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Entering 'mobile.snet.co.uk' into APN... Saving profile...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now restart your smartphone to initiate re-authentication with Deutsche Telekom.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Restarting phone now... Screen is rebooting...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The gateway will attempt to re-provision the data session.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Phone has rebooted... Signal bars show 'Telekom.de 4G' but there is an exclamation mark next to data and web pages still won't load!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Jason?! Hello?! Did you put me on mute again?! Why do you keep vanishing for forty seconds?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was polling the Frankfurt roaming switch for an authentication handshake.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why is data still blocked?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The international partner switch requires up to four hours to propagate bar removals across European cellular towers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Four hours?! My investor meeting starts in fifteen minutes!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There is no way to bypass foreign carrier propagation cycles.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I connect to Frankfurt Airport Wi-Fi in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Airport Wi-Fi is managed by the airport operator.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This has been an absolute disaster.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude, what was that mobile phone number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our call, it is 07700 900381.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, mobile number confirmed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you provide a ticket number for the complaint?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your roaming ticket reference is ROAM-ERR-88192-F.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ROAM-ERR-88192-F.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other query today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, your service has been utterly unacceptable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile roaming support. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
